title: Ribasim external surface-water production profile
production_changes: Port the Q4A stateless extended drainage/infiltration process.
Port the Q4B FMR drainage-response variant 9 binding.
Add a typed materializer from accepted external surface-water heads to drainage-response controls.
Add a transaction participant using canonical checkpoint/candidate/commit authority.
Reject any profile that also owns the same surface-water store through F-CI52 fixed-weir optional state.
hard_invariants: No SWST or other surface-water storage is added to SWAP committed state.
Template optional_state_layout_id must be BASE, never FIXED_WEIR_SURFACE_WATER.
Committed state must be the base physical state for this first profile, not a fixed-weir state.
Every active drainage response level must use FMR_DRAIN_VARIANT_EXTENDED_SIGNED.
The only surface-water hydraulic input to SWAP is a finite resolved external head per active drainage level.
Trial evaluation never mutates committed SWAP state.
If externally realized signed transfer differs from the SWAP candidate beyond frozen tolerance, commit is forbidden and the candidate must be discarded before retrial from the same accepted origin.
Mass remains booked exactly once by the canonical SWAP trial ledger.
A coupling window is admitted only when the SWAP candidate completes in exactly one accepted substep; whole-window multi-substep transfer publication is deferred.

geometry_decision.rationale: Avoid inventing an application acceptance epsilon. Ribasim surface-water geometry is authoritative for this first production profile; Q1H remains a separate legacy-geometry migration option.

initial_tests: owner XOR rejects fixed-weir optional-state template
owner XOR rejects fixed-weir committed-state carrier
external transfer mismatch blocks commit and supports discard/retrial from the same accepted origin
forcing materializer rejects wrong head vector, nonfinite head and preexisting competing drainage forcing/control
